task_title: Separate asset requests from hourly art ingestion

plan_review.notes: Addressed five concerns: intake now rejects asset-request/no-copilot labels and runs on labeling to close the race; CI authorization will require immutable workflow context plus an explicit marker; active batch PRs will use a stable body marker; mixed base branches will fail closed; and workflow shape/authorization tests will be added.

rounds.notes: Resolved the two applicable findings: replaced human-readable reason substring matching with a structured blocking flag, and fail-closed on check-in/requested base-branch mismatch. A separate pre-existing async test warning and a non-actionable query-size suggestion were not part of this change.
